data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'galax' meaning 'stranger' or 'traveler'. In medieval Europe, a gallagher was a traveler or a wanderer. The name is also found in the English surname Gallagher, which means 'foreigner' or 'outsider'. The name Gallager carries the meaning “Stranger, Traveler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gallager usually hope their child will grow to embody stranger, traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
